steps.title: Project Setup
steps.description: Initialize package structures and build configurations for Modern Calculator.

steps.title: Configure Manifest
steps.description: Set application permissions, entry activity, and theme configurations.

steps.title: Design Color Palette & Styles
steps.description: Create modern dark slate and violet color palettes and UI element styles.

steps.title: Create Drawable Layout Assets
steps.description: Build custom shape background gradients and rounded corner drawables for keypad buttons.

steps.title: Build Expression Evaluator Engine
steps.description: Implement a native recursive mathematical expression parser supporting standard and scientific functions.

steps.title: Create History Storage & Model
steps.description: Implement local data structure and list adapter for managing calculation history.

steps.title: Construct Calculator Main UI Layout
steps.description: Design responsive multi-tab layout with display screen, mode selector, standard keypad, scientific panel, and utility tools.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Controller
steps.description: Wire user interaction logic, button keypads, real-time expression rendering, and mode switching.

steps.title: Implement Scientific Function Operations
steps.description: Connect scientific functions including trig, logarithmic, roots, powers, factorials, and constants.

steps.title: Implement Quick Unit Converters
steps.description: Integrate real-time converters for Length, Weight, Area, and Temperature.

steps.title: Implement Financial Tools (BMI & Tip Splitter)
steps.description: Add dedicated calculators for BMI index and Tip & Bill splitting.

steps.title: Implement History & Clipboard Management
steps.description: Add memory dialog, tap-to-reuse expressions/results, clear history, and copy to clipboard.

steps.title: Verify Code Compatibility
steps.description: Validate Java 8 syntax compatibility and standard Android SDK requirements.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Final compilation pass to output assembleDebug APK artifact.
